title: Personal Loans Pricing and Disbursement Terms
content:
## Terms in force

Every Larkspur Personal Loans loan is a fixed-rate, simple-interest, fully amortizing installment loan.

- **Base interest rate.** At approval the base interest rate is the 36-month rate the underwriting model set inside the grade's floor-to-ceiling band, plus the grade's term adjustment for the chosen term, minus the grade's direct-pay discount when the borrower elected to have at least 75 percent (the grade's direct-pay minimum share) of net proceeds paid directly to no more than 10 (the grade's maximum number of) creditors.
- **Monthly installment.** The monthly installment is the level payment that repays the amount financed over the term at the base interest rate (monthly rate is the base rate divided by 1200), rounded to the cent, with any rounding difference absorbed by the final installment. In words: the amount financed times the monthly rate, divided by one less the reciprocal of one plus the monthly rate raised to the number of months in the term.
- **APR ceiling.** If the APR including the origination fee would exceed the grade's highest APR disclosed, the base rate is lowered until the APR equals that highest APR at most; if even the grade's rate floor cannot achieve this the application is declined.
- **Disbursement.** Disbursement lines are written only for a loan in active status on its funding date. At funding the loan amount is split into disbursement lines that sum exactly to the amount financed: one origination-fee-withheld line for the fee, one refinance payoff transfer line for the payoff amount of a refinance-purpose payoff quote good through the funding date (refinance loans only), one creditor direct-pay line per creditor paid directly, and one borrower deposit line for the remainder to the borrower's verified linked account (no line when the remainder is 0.00). Funds are sent the grade's funding business days after signing.

## Clauses no longer in force as general terms

The two clauses below are no longer in force as terms of every loan; they are superseded for a refinance application whose amount financed is sized from the payoff it retires, where the fee percent, the amount it is charged on and whether it is withheld are set by that sizing.

> The origination fee is the grade's origination fee percent of the amount financed, rounded to the cent; on a refinance loan (loan purpose refinance of an existing loan) that percent is first reduced by the grade's refinance origination fee reduction, never below zero.

> The fee is withheld from the loan amount, so net proceeds equal the amount financed minus the fee, and interest accrues on the full amount financed.

Every other loan's origination fee is the grade's origination fee percent of the amount financed, rounded to the cent, first reduced on a refinance loan by the grade's refinance origination fee reduction, never below zero, and every other loan's fee is withheld from the loan amount, so net proceeds equal the amount financed minus the fee; on every loan interest accrues on the full amount financed.

## Worked installment (hypothetical figures)

An amount financed of 6000.00 USD over 36 months at a base rate of 18.00 percent has a monthly rate of 18.00 divided by 1200, or 0.015. The level payment is 6000.00 times 0.015, divided by one less the reciprocal of 1.015 raised to the 36th power, which rounds to 216.91 USD.

## Disbursement lines (hypothetical non-refinance loan)

An amount financed of 10000.00 USD with a fee of 500.00 USD and one creditor paid 7000.00 USD directly is split into a 500.00 fee-withheld line, a 7000.00 creditor line and a 2500.00 borrower deposit line, together 10000.00.

superseded_clauses: The origination fee is the grade's origination fee percent of the amount financed, rounded to the cent; on a refinance loan (loan purpose refinance_existing_loan) that percent is first reduced by the grade's refinance origination fee reduction, never below zero.
The fee is withheld from the loan amount, so net proceeds equal the amount financed minus the fee, and interest accrues on the full amount financed.
